title: Universal Neural Optimal Transport
one_line_en: Trains a Fourier Neural Operator to predict the entropic-OT dual potential for arbitrary pairs of discrete measures at arbitrary resolution, using an adversarial measure generator plus a self-supervised bootstrapping loss whose minimisation provably bounds the loss against the true potential; yields state-of-the-art Sinkhorn initialisation with up to 7.4x speedup.
one_line_zh: 用 Fourier Neural Operator 预测熵 OT 的对偶势，输入是任意一对离散测度、任意分辨率；训练靠一个可证明覆盖全部非负分布的对抗生成器 + 一个自监督 bootstrapping 损失（目标由 5 步 Sinkhorn 给出，Prop. 5 保证它压住与真解的误差），因此不依赖任何真实数据集。是目前唯一做到跨数据集与跨分辨率泛化的摊销 OT 求解器，也是评估条件 GFlowNet-OT 泛化能力的强基线。
